narrative.intro: Airbus Us Space and Defense obligated $253M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Airbus Us Space and Defense won 8 awards so far, with an average award size of $31.6M. Obligations fell 22.6% year over year. The Department of Defense is the dominant buyer, obligating $253M. The Department of Justice and the Department of Homeland Security appear as much smaller buyers, obligating $156K and $12.5K respectively. Other Support Activities for Air Transportation is the primary market, with $253M obligated in that NAICS. Secondary markets include Computer and Computer Peripheral Equipment and Software Merchant Wholesalers at $156K, Other Aircraft Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing at $12.5K, and Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences at $500. Fiscal-year history shows obligations of $220M in FY21, $255M in FY22, $356M in FY23, $348M in FY24, $327M in FY25, and $253M in FY26 to date. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity only. This snapshot highlights concentration in a single agency and a single market for the reporting period.
